FINDING SOURCE (the 2 emitted): compliance.rs:67 defines a db_error() helper whose doc-comment explicitly states 'Compliance handlers must never surface raw SQLx / DB errors to the caller: their Display output leaks table and column names, SQL fragments, and connection details' - it logs server-side via tracing::error! and returns an opaque 'Internal server error'. This is the repo's documented convention and is guarded by the regression test compliance.rs:907 db_error_does_not_leak_raw_detail_to_client. DESPITE that convention, grep found 135 sites in routes/ that build ErrorResponse::new("DB_ERROR", e.to_string()) - i.e. serialize the raw sqlx::Error Display straight into the JSON response body - plus 562 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR responses echoing e.to_string(). Offending modules include budgets.rs, emergency/{protocols,statistics,broadcasts,contacts,drills,incidents}.rs, subscriptions.rs, feature_packages.rs, messaging.rs, and legal.rs. The legal.rs:105 db_error(msg,e) helper is the clearest instance: it is positioned as the module's error-mapper, logs the error server-side with tracing::error!, and THEN still returns e.to_string() to the client - a sanitizer that does not sanitize.

evidence: Convention: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/compliance.rs:67 db_error() documents that raw sqlx::Error Display 'leaks table and column names, SQL fragments, and connection details' and returns an opaque 500; regression-tested at compliance.rs:907 (db_error_does_not_leak_raw_detail_to_client).

Violation: ~135 sites in backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/ build ErrorResponse::new("DB_ERROR", e.to_string()) - serializing the raw sqlx::Error Display into the HTTP response body - and ~562 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR responses echo e.to_string() to the client.

Affected modules include budgets.rs, emergency/{protocols,statistics,broadcasts,contacts,drills,incidents}.rs, subscriptions.rs, feature_packages.rs, messaging.rs (e.g. require_message_in_thread error map ~line 1871).

Fix: route these through a sanitizing helper (log e server-side via tracing::error!, return an opaque 500 body) exactly as compliance.rs / my_units / unit_residents already do; no behavior or schema change.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/legal.rs:105 fn db_error(msg, e) logs the error server-side (tracing::error!) and then returns Json(ErrorResponse::new("DB_ERROR", e.to_string())) - leaking the raw sqlx::Error Display (table/column names, SQL fragments) to the API client.

This directly contradicts the repo's documented sanitize-DB-errors convention in backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/compliance.rs:67 (regression-tested at compliance.rs:907). A helper named db_error that is the module's error-mapper is the natural single-point fix.
Fix: change the returned ErrorResponse message to a static opaque string (e.g. "Internal server error"); the server-side tracing::error! already preserves the detail for operators.
